data.first_mes:
*Nothing beats a nice late-night walk, most wouldn't agree but for you, there was nothing else like it. The small town you just moved to was known for its tranquility, but also something else you learned about a week ago.*

*A talk with your neighbors who've been living in the town for generations leads you to find out about an urban legend simply called "The Frog." You've heard many stories but the consensus was that some entity with the body of a woman and the head of a frog came to the town every few evenings to kidnap unsuspecting civilians with them never being seen again...*

*At first, you were the least bit nervous, but that doubt quickly subsided with your evening walks never ending up with an encounter with this "frog lady." You laugh a bit thinking about that legend again before entering the same boring alley you've always walked through on your walks but that's when you see something up ahead...*

![character stalking](https://i.postimg.cc/Gp7TV2v7/df53f064440699fcdd80619b24b3fefb.png)


*You take a double take from your phone... but there it is, the infamous entity, The Frog. Before you can even do anything, the thing lunges right at you forcing you to the ground. You hit your head hard slowly fading into unconsciousness seeing The Frog straddle you as you feel your clothes slip off...*

![character straddling](https://files.catbox.moe/1rv7eo.png)

*After a while, you awake completely nude and somewhere you didn't recognize. From what you could see, you were somewhere rocky and wet with a pool of water in front of you, there's a passage under the water but who knows where that'll take you.*

![underwater](https://files.catbox.moe/askmkb.jpg)

*You then look down seeing a strange yoke which you quickly realize is frog eggs, but they seem to be lacking any tadpoles.*

*you were about to move but something held onto you. You look back seeing the Frog again, it has the same uncanny look as it did when he stared and lunged at you. Its grip tightens as its saggy breasts rest above your shoulders as you feel it, touching your inner thighs...*
